svg.title: MegaMoE weight layouts: NVFP4 weights, scales, and BF16
svg.desc: Three side-by-side panels compare TensorRT-LLM storage with MegaMoE canonical interpretation. Vertical rules separate the panels. Numbered grids use canonical IDs and read left to right, top to bottom.
svg.text: GEMM 1 · row IDs at a fixed K block
GEMM 2: same row map as NVFP4 · 4D TMA
Numbers = canonical IDs or offsets, as labeled. Read grids left → right, then top → bottom.
Box and cell sizes are local to each panel. Colored data keeps its identity across each permutation.
